describe: First publication dates of series that are not yet in the bindings catalogue. A series in the catalogue carries its date in its binding (first_published), and selection refuses any value dated earlier. The series here are bound only inside RFC-005's registration; when they are added to the catalogue the date moves into the binding and the entry leaves this file.

series.basis: Cboe announced it would begin publishing SKEW values on 2011-02-23.
Cboe's release introducing the index is dated 2012-03-14.
